County Mission Statement
The government of Norton County exists to serve the people of Norton County in a professional, progressive, and cost-effective manner so all our citizens may enjoy a protected quality of life, while preserving our unique character and cultures and without regard to personal or special interests.

The Canvass will begin at 9:00a.m. in the County Commission Room, at the Norton County Courthouse 105 S.
